notes.title: Level Variant Selection Added & Patch Applied
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!

Based on your feedback, we've got a couple of updates released in the most recent build:

[h3]Updated main menu to provide level variant selection[/h3]
Previously, there were some issues with procedural selection of rooms. Hopefully, these explicit options will alleviate those issues, as well as aid achievement hunters in reporting all possible anomalies.

[h3]Fix for crashes some players are experiencing[/h3]
If you are still experiencing crashing, please let us know via the following google form:

[url=https://forms.gle/cHUfcfXgk95SQt2Y7]https://forms.gle/cHUfcfXgk95SQt2Y7[/url]

Good hunting Agents
